newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Pannon-Flax to buy spinning plant.
newsitem.headline: Pannon-Flax to buy spinning plant.

text.p: Hungarian textile producer Pannon-Flax Gyori Lenszovo Rt said on Wednesday that it had won a tender and would start negotiations soon to buy the assets of the Lorinci plant of Masterfil Rt.
Pannon-Flax will continue talks to buy the building and the machinery of the spinning plant, Pannon-Flax's chairwoman and general director Etelka Teimel told Reuters.
She declined to go into financials.
Separately, Pannon-Flax announced that board member Andras Okros, former finance director of Fotex, had resigned due to other commitments. Okros joined Pannon-Flax early this year.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange on Wednesday Pannon-Flax ended at 405 forints, up five.
